entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Apprehending their arrest, the petitioners have moved this Court for grant of privilege of
anticipatory bail in connection with Baliapur P.S. Case No.55 of 2022 registered under sections
323/341/ 342/376/313/504/506/498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code and under Section 4/6 of the
Pocso Act, 2012.

The Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the allegation against the petitioners is that the petitioner no.1 has committed rape upon his wife being the minor girl and the petitioner no.2 is the mother-in-law of the minor girl.

It is further submitted that the allegations against the petitioners are all false and admittedly, the petitioner no.1 solemnized marriage with the victim in presence of the mother of the victim in the Bhuibhod Temple, Dhanbad.

It is next submitted that the petitioner no.1 is ready and willing to keep and maintain the victim-daughter of the informant with full dignity and honour as his lawful wife if and when she is ready and willing to resume conjugal life with the petitioner.

It is then submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that on the date of marriage on 04.03.2022, the victim was a major lady being of 18 years 1 month 2 days old and she Vishal Kumar Singh @ Vishal Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr. .... ... on 16 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/91034543/
1 was not a minor and she consented for the marriage.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is lastly submitted that the petitioners undertake to jointly pay Rs.25,000/- to the informant without prejudice to their defence in this case and also undertake to cooperate with the investigation of the case.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioners be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Addl. P.P. and the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 opposes the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail.

It is further submitted by the learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 that the date of birth of the victim is 03.02.2006 and not 02.03.2004 as mentioned in the copy of the Aadhar Card which was submitted in the temple at the time of her marriage with the petitioner no.1.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioners ought not to be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.

Considering the submissions of the counsels and the fact and circumstances of the case, as admittedly the victim has solemnized marriage with the petitioner no.1 and the petitioner no.1 is ready and willing to keep and maintain the victim with full dignity and honour as his lawful wife and undisputedly, an Aadhar Card of the victim was produced at the temple where the marriage was solemnized to show her date of birth to be 03.02.2004, this Court is inclined to give the privilege of anticipatory bail to the above named petitioners.

Hence, in the event of their arrest or surrender within a period of six weeks from the date of this order, they shall be released on bail on jointly depositing a demand draft of Rs.25,000/- drawn in favour of informant without prejudice to their defence in this case and on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand)
each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Additional Sessions Judge-IX-cum-Special Judge, POCSO, Dhanbad, in connection with Baliapur P.S. Case No.55 of 2022 with the condition that the petitioners will cooperate with the investigation of the case and appear before the Investigating Officer as and when noticed by him and will furnish their mobile number and a copy of their Aadhar Card in the court below with the undertaking that they will not change their mobile number during the pendency of the case with further condition that petitioner no.1 will keep and maintain the victim-daughter of the informant with full dignity and honour as his lawful wife if and when she is ready and willing to resume conjugal life with the petitioner and subject to the conditions laid down under section 438 (2) Cr. P.C.
In case, the petitioners deposit the aforesaid demand draft, the court below is directed to issue notice to the informant and hand over the said demand draft to her, after proper identification.
(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Sonu/Gunjan- Vishal Kumar Singh @ Vishal Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand & Anr. .... ...
